sentences.text: Admission Process in All Government and Non-Government Schools of the State

**Scheme Brief Description:** The scheme aims to provide free and accessible education for children from Class 1 to 8 by offering free education and essential learning materials, including books, shoe-bags, and meals, across all government and non-government schools in the state.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Education & Learning; Sector: Resources for schools

**Detailed Description:** The &quot;Admission Process in All Government and Non-Government Schools of the State&quot; scheme is implemented by the Basic Education Department under the Department of Education, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to provide free and accessible education for children from Class 1 to 8 by offering free education and essential learning materials, including books, shoe-bags, and meals, across all government and non-government schools in the state.
**Benefits / Assistance:** After admission in all Government and Non-Government schools of the state, children from Class 1 to 8 receive free education, meals, books, and shoe-bags.

**Application Process:** - Admission to Class 1 in government and private schools begins every year in April. - For the admission process, any one of the following documents can be submitted as proof of the student’s age: the child’s hospital/ANM record, Anganwadi record, village/family register, or a declaration by the guardian/parents regarding the child’s age. - In case the student is transferring from another school, the school leaving/transfer certificate (TC) from the previous school is mandatory.
**Contacts & Authorities:** Implementing agency: Basic Education Department, Government Of Uttarakhand; Nodal Department: Department Of Education
**Tags:** Free Education, Student, Anganwadi Bal Vatika, Admission In School
